messages.content: The airline moved our Sunday PWM-ORD flight from 1:25 p.m. to 11:50 a.m. That seems too tight with the Hyatt checkout, fuel, the car return, and the shuttle. Compare keeping it with the later nonstop, including the full cost for all three of us.

The replacement 11:50 a.m. nonstop arrives Chicago at 1:43 p.m. Keeping it costs nothing, but the practical plan would be to leave Hyatt Place Portland-Old Port by 7:55 a.m., fuel near the airport, return the SUV to the Avis Westbrook Street lot around 8:40, and catch the shuttle at 8:45 or 9:00. With service every 15 minutes, you should reach the terminal around 9:10, giving about 2 hours 40 minutes. That protects the flight, but effectively gives up the final morning and requires checkout more than three hours early.

There is a 4:40 p.m. PWM-ORD nonstop arriving at 6:33 p.m. It currently has three economy seats and costs $67 more per passenger, so the total fare increase is $201. The one checked bag per person remains attached without another bag charge.
What would the airport timing look like for that one? We still need to be out of the Hyatt on time.

You could check out at noon, leave around 12:20 p.m., fuel, and return the SUV at the same Westbrook Street lot by about 1:05. A 1:15 shuttle should put you at PWM around 1:30, leaving roughly 3 hours 10 minutes before departure. Even missing one shuttle would still leave about 2 hours 55 minutes.
That is clearly the better day. I would rather pay the $201 and keep the afternoon than force everyone out before eight. Are the three seats together?
Yes. Seats 18A, 18B, and 18C are available together on the 4:40 p.m. flight. The airline shows no separate seat charge for those assignments.
Move Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee to it, keep those seats, and preserve all three checked bags.

The change is confirmed under M7Q4LP. Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee are now on the July 19 PWM-ORD nonstop departing at 4:40 p.m. and arriving at 6:33 p.m., in seats 18A, 18B, and 18C. One checked bag per traveler remains included. The additional $201 has been charged. Keep the Hyatt through its noon checkout, leave around 12:20 p.m., return the SUV to the Avis Westbrook Street lot near 1:05, and use the 15-minute shuttle for an expected terminal arrival around 1:30, providing a 3-hour-10-minute margin.
